title: Module stalk comparison and geometric-fibre restriction factorization
statement: Let f:X -> Y be quasi-compact and quasi-separated, s:Spec Omega -> Y a geometric point with Omega algebraically closed, F an etale sheaf of Lambda-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and (g′:X′ -> X,f′:X′ -> Spec Omega,f,s) Cartesian [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Let A be the pointed-neighbourhood ring colimit [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], with any IsLocalRing structure, and rho:Spec A -> Y its structural map [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. Put T=X times_Y Spec A, with projections q:T -> X and p:T -> Spec A. There exist t:Spec Omega -> Spec A with t rho=s and image the closed point, and i:X′ -> T with i q=g′ and (i,f′,p,t) Cartesian. There are module isomorphisms Theta:(f_*F)_s -> Gamma(T,q^*F) and b:Gamma(X′,i^*q^*F) -> (g′^*F)(id_X′), such that for every pointed etale neighbourhood (V,v) and section z in F(V times_Y X), b applied to restriction along i of Theta(germ(z)) equals the inverse-image unit restriction along the iterated pullback lift with projections (f′ followed by v,g′) and id_X′. This statement asserts no injectivity of the restriction along i and imposes no integral or proper hypothesis.

source.place: Tags 03Q9 and 03Q1; strict henselization construction in Tag 04HX

proof.text: Obtain the official full-presentation comparison. Base change Spec.map of the canonical small/full ring-colimit isomorphism to get an isomorphism over X. Compose the official comparison with globalSectionsUpperStarIso and the inverse-image composition isomorphism. The general unitSectionRestriction_comp equation transports each germ formula; pullback extensionality shows that base change commutes with symmetry and hence identifies the transported full-model leg with the small-model leg. All subsequent objects and the displayed conclusion remain in the original small presentation.

The marked maps define a cone on the double-opposite small affine diagram after composition with the Gamma-Spec unit. Naturality follows from Scheme.toSpecΓ_naturality and the point equation of each category-of-elements morphism. Lift this cone to strictHenselizationCone using the IsLimit furnished by strictHenselization_properties. Its fac equations and toSpecΓ_SpecMap_ΓSpecIso_inv give the pointed limit-leg equations. Choose one object using cofiltered nonemptiness and use strictHenselizationStructuralMap_eq and its marked point equation to get t followed by the structural map equal to s.

Apply strictHenselizationStructuralMap_fiber_eq_closedPoint_compat from the canonical small-to-full comparison to the identity spectrum isomorphism and t(closedPoint Omega); the premise is t followed by the structural map equal to s, evaluated at the closed point. Construct i by pullback.lift with projections g-prime and f-prime followed by t. The projection equations follow from lift_fst and lift_snd. Cancel the right pullback square with IsPullback.of_right to obtain the required Cartesian square.
Obtain Theta and its representative formula directly from exists_qcqsStrictLocalModuleComparison. This is the existing generic qcqs continuity tool; neither properness nor torsion is used.

At the identity geometric point, the identity marked neighbourhood is initial in the category of elements: the unique pointed arrow to (V,v) is the marked section v itself. Uniqueness follows by taking the left component of the pointed-arrow equation. Its opposite is terminal, so IsColimit.isIso_ι_app_of_isTerminal applied to isColimitPresheafFiberCocone proves the terminal germ j is an isomorphism. Let eX and eOmega be the global-section/identity-section isomorphisms. Define d as eX.inv, lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso.inv, eOmega.hom and j. Define b as global sections of upperStarComp.inv followed by eX.hom. All factors of d are isomorphisms.

Derive the small-model compatibility directly, without the retired specialization. Cancel the geometric source-stalk isomorphism and apply colimit hom-ext after whiskering by the initial small affine pointed-neighbourhood functor. On each representative use exchange_pointed_representative. Apply unitSectionRestriction_comp to the small limit leg and q (or i). Pullback hom-ext identifies its graph with geometricFibreSectionLift: the first inner projection is f′ followed by the marked point by the small leg first projection, hqt (or hit), and hpoint; the second is g′ by the second projection and hq (or hi); the outer second projections are identities. Expand unitSectionRestriction, postcompose by the terminal evaluation factors, use the comparison germ formula, and reassociate. The colimit equality gives the unchanged exchange factorization. Then cancel sourceIso.inv followed by sourceIso.hom in exchange_pointed_representative for every V,v, and cancel the monic terminal-comparison d.hom; evaluate at z to obtain the required fibre restriction formula.

lean.statement: theorem strictHenselizationModuleFibre_factorization (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {X' X Y : Scheme.{u}} {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Spec (.of Ω)} {f : X ⟶ Y} {s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y} (sq : IsPullback g' f' f s) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] [IsLocalRing (strictHenselizationRing s)] (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) : ∃ (t : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ strictHenselizationScheme s) (ht : t ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap s = s), t (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) = IsLocalRing.closedPoint (strictHenselizationRing s) ∧ ∃ (i : X' ⟶ pullback f (strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)), IsPullback i f' (pullback.snd f (strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)) t ∧ i ≫ pullback.fst f (strictHenselizationStructuralMap s) = g' ∧ ∃ Θ : (pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber.obj ((f)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F) ≅ (Sheaf.Γ _ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj ((pullback.fst f (strictHenselizationStructuralMap s))^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F), ∃ b : (Sheaf.Γ _ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj ((i)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj ((pullback.fst f (strictHenselizationStructuralMap s))^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F)) ≅ ((g')^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F).obj.obj (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X'))), ∀ (V : Y.Etale) (v : (pointSmallEtale s).fiber.obj V) (z : F.obj.obj (op (f.Etale.obj V))), b.hom.hom ((globalSectionsUpperStarMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) i ((pullback.fst f (strictHenselizationStructuralMap s))^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F)).hom (Θ.hom.hom ((pointSmallEtale s).toPresheafFiber V v ((f)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F).obj z))) = (geometricFibreSectionRestriction Λ sq.toCommSq F V v).hom z
